title: dunalia lorentzii

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat anxiety, insomnia, and other sleep disorders due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Dunalia lorentzii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, such as scopolamine and hyoscyamine, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Dunalia lorentzii are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties.
